messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: high error rate observed for /console/api/v1/config (region: us-east-1). Alert threshold breached (5xx > 8% over 5m). Incident channel created.

Dan_oncall: I'm on it. Seeing customers report console UI errors and some API 502s. ETA for first check: 5m. @alice_sre can you grab prod logs?

alice_sre: grabbing logs now. Initial grep shows a flurry of `ERROR: config-fetch failure` from console-proxy pool. Suspect control-plane config propagation lag or a feature flag roll.

ben_runtime: adding context — earlier this morning we rolled out `console-config-cache` change (sharded cache invalidation) at 05:12 UTC to dedicated cluster. No anomalies in CI. Any chance the new invalidation TTL ended up as 0?

carla_product: several enterprise customers on Dedicated reported UI blank panels. Support ticket count +1 from EVA. Carla to coordinate customer comms.

EVA_support: customer-impact: ~7 customers hitting front-end errors, most on Dedicated us-east-1. Tickets created: 12345, 12346. Not many errors from Hosted customers.

frank_eng: hypothesis: this is a control-plane propagation issue — the console UI fetches model of route from control plane; if the control plane responds with a malformed config or 500, the UI shows blank. Alternatively could be dataplane (runtime) rejecting requests due to new cache-invalidation behavior. We need to confirm which side is failing.

alice_sre: collecting timelines. Pulling logs from console-proxy and control-plane-config-service. Attaching snippets below.

```
# /var/log/console-proxy/2026-03-15.log
[05:17:01] INFO  fetch config for tenant=acme-corp v=2026-03-15T05:17:00Z
[05:17:02] ERROR fetch failed status=502 upstream=controlplane-config-service err="no config in cache"
[05:17:02] WARN  fallback to minimal config
[05:17:02] ERROR render failed template=dashboard tenant=acme-corp err="missing widgets"
```

```
# /var/log/controlplane-config/2026-03-15.log
[05:16:58] INFO  incoming write for tenant=acme-corp version=2026-03-15T05:16:58Z flag=sharded-cache-ttl=0
[05:16:59] INFO  publish config to region=us-east-1 subscribers=17
[05:17:00] ERROR push to subscriber console-proxy-12 status=504 timeout
[05:17:01] ERROR push to subscriber console-proxy-9 status=502 handshake-failed
```

ben_runtime: that `flag=sharded-cache-ttl=0` line is worrying. If TTL is 0, our runtime treats it as immediate eviction and may return empty cache responses. Could be a bad default from the rollout.

dan_oncall: mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily pin console traffic to fallback config (read-only minimal) to reduce 5xx noise 2) revert the TTL flag to previous value 3) restart problematic subscribers that show handshake failures. Which is fastest?

frank_eng: fastest is to revert the feature flag gate at control plane -> set `sharded-cache-ttl` back to prior value (e.g., 300s). I can push a rollback patch. Requires control-plane deploy or an emergency toggle if available.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by frank_eng: rollback-console-cache-ttl -> target=controlplane-config-service/us-east-1 -> change=sharded-cache-ttl:300 -> CI checks skipped -> approver required.

alice_sre: while waiting for rollback, I'll add an iptables rule to route console-proxy-12/9 traffic to a healthy instance group in us-east-1 as a stop-gap. That should reduce error footprint for affected tenants.

carla_product: I'll prepare customer note: short, honest, ETA for fix ~15-25m, and we'll follow up with RCA. Please update me when rollback completes or if we need a wider mitigation.

EVA_support: asking for contact list for customers impacted; will escalate to account owners.

ben_runtime: quick check commands for runtime folks: `kubectl -n controlplane get deploy controlplane-config -o yaml | grep sharded-cache-ttl` and `kubectl -n console get pods -l app=console-proxy -o wide`

alice_sre: ran checks: deploy shows TTL=0 in current config map. Pod health: some console-proxy pods show `CrashLoopBackOff` and increased restart_count.

frank_eng: I'm applying emergency toggle now via the management console (avoiding full deploy). Patching config for us-east-1 to `sharded-cache-ttl=300`. Will post when done.

frank_eng: patch applied. controlplane-config-service acked publish. Observability shows publish time 05:19:03.

alice_sre: observing downstream: console-proxy-9 reconnects at 05:19:06. 5xx rate trending down. Patching logs:

```
[05:19:06] INFO  reloaded config from controlplane version=2026-03-15T05:19:03Z
[05:19:07] INFO  cache warmup complete
[05:19:08] INFO  requests healthy
```

Dan_oncall: good, monitor for 10 more minutes and then start rolling restart of nodes that crashed. Carla, please send interim update to customers: rollback applied, monitoring.

carla_product: sending now. EVA, paste customer note here?

EVA_support: posted canned update to affected customers and created task for account owners.

ben_runtime: follow-up tasks (RCA coordination): 1) build timeline of the original flag rollout and who changed the default value 2) collect all control-plane publish logs + per-subscriber handshake failures 3) confirm there wasn't a secondary dataplane bug that exacerbated crashes (e.g., mem leak) 4) test the sharded-cache-ttl validation in staging to prevent 0.

alice_sre: uploading full logs to GCS bucket: gs://redwood-incident-logs/2094056789/ . I'll add links to the post-incident doc.

frank_eng: quick hypothesis notes to capture in-thread: - root cause: config default change pushed TTL=0 -> immediate eviction -> subscribers receiving empty config -> render failures -> 5xxs. - contributing: push delivery timeouts (network blips) caused some subscribers to crash rather than fallback gracefully. - mitigation: emergency toggle + restart, customer communications.

carla_product: adding severity / customer impact summary to doc: Affects Dedicated customers in us-east-1 (console experiences degraded), no data loss, estimated impact window 05:16–05:20 UTC.

Dan_oncall: handing off to alice_sre for post-incident work. I'm stepping off the bridge in 10 min; if anything new, @frank_eng take lead.

alice_sre: taking lead for RCA. Next actions: assemble timeline, label logs, add correlation with deploy-bot logs, and propose code validation to block TTL=0 on write. I'll open a postmortem draft in #postmortems and link it here.

frank_eng: small note — we should add a guard in control-plane UI to disallow zero TTLs for sharded cache flags. I'll file a PR after RCA.

carla_product: thanks all. Closing incident thread when postmortem link is up.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: error rate returned to baseline. Total duration: 4 minutes. Postmortem tracking id: PM-2094056789 (in #postmortems).
